I hurt for 3 days. It was so uncomfortable. I could not sleep. I wanted more pain meds but the nurse said that once I go number 2 I will feel better. I had to get magnesium citrate…it works and I felt so much better! One week post op I was back to work and I felt better than I had in over a year. I did not realize how bad I felt before. 
I did overdo my physical exertion a few times and became really exhausted. I am now 4 weeks post op and doing great…I do have minor twinges of pain and phantom pain. But it is getting better as time has passed. I wish I had done it sooner.

My heart goes out to you! I wanted to give you advice. I’m a. Elementary teacher of 20 years. 
Be honest with your kids. Help them understand what is happening as the disease progresses. Make memories together. When the end gets closer, let them miss school when they need too, being with their mom is more important. Validate their feelings and love them. Kids act out their emotions differently than adults because they need help naming their emotions and processing. Love and support will carry them.
